svg.aria-label: The cross-coupled system dx1/dt = −x1 + g(x2), dx2/dt = −x2 + h(x1) with g(u) = 0.5 sin u and h(u) = 0.5 u cos u, both bounded by |u|/2. Trajectories cut the circles V = x1 squared + x2 squared inwards, as the Lyapunov argument guarantees
